Update Makefile for React build
description:
Update Makefile to support both frontends:

Option A (Recommended): Replace Lit with React
- Change build-frontend to build from web-react/ instead of web/
- Update clean target to include web-react/
- Update dev target for React dev server

Option B: Support both frontends
- Add build-frontend-react target
- Add FRONTEND=react/lit variable
- Conditional logic in build-backend

Recommendation: Go with Option A (full replacement) since this is a migration, not parallel support.

Changes:
- build-frontend: cd web-react && npm install && npm run build
- clean: add web-react/dist, web-react/node_modules
- dev: cd web-react && npm run dev
